name: Idaho
summary: Statutes and Constitution: legislature.idaho.gov serves one HTML page per section, constructible from the citation (chapter = section digits minus the last two, or the middle number in three-part UPC/UCC sections), current through the 2026 session; Justia 2025 is the tier-2 fallback. Court rules: isc.idaho.gov serves every I.R.C.P./I.A.R./I.R.E./I.C.R. rule on its own constructible print page; full-set pages are 120K-420K characters and truncate in the fetch tool. IDAPA rules and the Administrative Bulletin are chapter/issue PDFs at constructible adminrules.idaho.gov URLs that redirect to files.dfm.idaho.gov (the fetch tool will not follow that redirect; the script does); Cornell LII mirrors IDAPA per section. Case law: the new isc.idaho.gov site is a JavaScript app, but its public GET JSON API (/api/cms-content-search, /api/cms-document) finds Supreme Court (late 2019 on) and Court of Appeals (2013-16, 2020 on) opinions by docket or party and links slip PDFs the script reads; Justia covers 1866 on; old isc.idaho.gov opinion URLs now 404; iCourt is behind a Cloudflare challenge.

citation_map.notes: Idaho Code sections are cited 'Idaho Code § 5-219', 'I.C. § 5-219' (Idaho courts' own style) or 'section 5-219, Idaho Code' (statutory cross-reference style); Bluebook uses 'Idaho Code Ann. § 5-219'. Two-part sections (title-NNNN[A]) encode the chapter as the digits before the last two (5-219 → ch. 2; 18-4001 → ch. 40; 67-5279 → ch. 52; 63-3022A → ch. 30); three-part sections in uniform-act titles (15 UPC, 28 UCC, 30 business entities, etc.) give the chapter in the middle (15-2-101 → ch. 2). The regex reads '§§ 5-216 to 5-219' as its first section and never reads a hyphenated range as a three-part section (three-part needs a 1-2 digit middle and 3-4 digit tail). Guards: bare 'I.C.' is routed only when followed by § or a T-NNN section number; bare 'Rule 56', 'Evidence Rule 702' or 'Criminal Rule 35' without an Idaho marker must not route here; 'I.R.E.' and 'I.C.R.' collide with other states' informal abbreviations, so route on them only with Idaho context. Rule-set aliases map to the isc.idaho.gov print-page slug in law_aliases. Unpublished Court of Appeals opinions are marked 'THIS IS AN UNPUBLISHED OPINION AND SHALL NOT BE CITED AS AUTHORITY' and are cited by docket number and date. Idaho has no public-domain citation; reporter cites are Idaho Reports (West) parallel with P./P.2d/P.3d, with '(Ct. App. YYYY)' for the Court of Appeals in Idaho style. Docket numbers are five digits, sometimes with a filing-year suffix ('46085-2018'); a granted petition for review moves the case to a NEW Supreme Court docket number (46085-2018 → 48109-2020). CourtListener ids 'idaho' and 'idahoctapp' are from memory and unverified. Interstate: Idaho shares the Snake River boundary with Oregon; no compact surfaced during probing.

sources.title: Idaho Statutes (Idaho Code)
sources.official_status_evidence: Site Disclaimer (https://legislature.idaho.gov/site-disclaimer/) says official copies of the Idaho Code are published for the Idaho Code Commission by LEXIS Publishing; no UELMA authentication statement on section pages.
sources.coverage: All titles of the Idaho Code, one HTML page per section with history note; per-chapter PDF downloads.

access.pattern_rules: title and chapter unpadded integers. Two-part section 'T-NNNN[A]': chapter = section digits without the last two (5-219 → T5CH2/SECT5-219; 18-4001 → T18CH40/SECT18-4001; 67-5279 → T67CH52/SECT67-5279; 63-3022A → T63CH30/SECT63-3022A). Three-part section 'T-C-NNN': chapter = middle number, section kept whole (15-2-101 → Title15/T15CH2/SECT15-2-101; 28-9-109 → Title28/T28CH9/SECT28-9-109). Letter suffix upper-case (SECT5-214A). Path is case-insensitive (search engines index the lower-case form title5/t5ch2/sect5-219/). A wrong chapter or non-existent section returns HTTP 404 ('not found'), so a bad guess is detectable; then use the chapter index, which lists every section number and catchline.
access.navigation: Fallback when the chapter cannot be inferred: /statutesrules/idstat/Title{title}/ lists chapters (titles only, NO section ranges) → /Title{title}/T{title}CH{chapter}/ lists every section with catchline → SECT page holds text.

access.pattern_rules: IDAPA AA.TT.CC[.SSS] → /rules/current/AA/AATTCC.pdf (58.01.02 → /rules/current/58/580102.pdf). The URL 301-redirects to https://files.dfm.idaho.gov/dfm-admin-website/rules/current/AA/AATTCC.pdf. Archive years: /rules/{YYYY}%20Archive/AA/AATTCC.pdf (2021, 2025 verified). Section SSS is a heading inside the PDF ('010. DEFINITIONS.'), grep it. A 404 means the chapter number is not current — IDAPA 16 (Health and Welfare) chapters were renumbered (16.03.09, 16.03.10 → 404; 16.03.01 OK).

automation.notes: WebFetch does not follow the cross-host redirect to files.dfm.idaho.gov and was refused the files.dfm URL (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). sources.title: Idaho Supreme Court and Court of Appeals opinions (isc.idaho.gov)
sources.official_status_evidence: Opinions page: 'subject to formal revision before publication in the preliminary print of the Pacific Reporter'; West publishes Idaho Reports and P.3d.
sources.coverage: Slip-opinion PDFs. Supreme Court ('ISC Opinion'): earliest entry 2019-09-11 (2018 tag holds petition-for-review orders), full years 2020-2026. Court of Appeals ('ICA Opinion', incl. unpublished and per curiam): 2013-2016 and 2020-2026; 2017-2019 essentially absent (2017: 1 record; 2018-2019: 0).

access.pattern_rules: Plain GET JSON. q matches docket number (result 'name' = docket, e.g. '53539' or '50045.pdf') and party names in the summary ('Dorff' → 48119). Optional tag={year}, sort_by=entry_date&sort_direction=DESC|ASC, cursor={nextCursor}. Then GET https://isc.idaho.gov/api/cms-document?id={id} → content[0].content.opinion_file.value.url = https://api.isc.idaho.gov/uploads/Documents/{ISC|ICA}/{Category}/{year}/{timestamp}-{docket}.pdf (not constructible: timestamp prefix). Categories: ISC Civil, ISC Criminal, ICA Civil, ICA Criminal & Post-Conviction, ICA Unpublished, ICA Unpublished Per Curiam.
access.read_via: PDFs on api.isc.idaho.gov (no robots.txt; 'Cannot GET /robots.txt' 404) — fetch_doc.py reads them in full.

automation.notes: The HTML listing pages (/cases-opinions/isc-opinions, /cases-opinions/ica-opinions) are a Nuxt JavaScript app: WebFetch saw only the search form, no opinions. WebFetch refuses API/PDF URLs that did not come from a search result (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). All old-site opinion URLs (isc.idaho.gov/opinions/*.pdf, /print/appeals-court/*) return 404; /appeals-court/isc_civil 301s to the new page.

hazards: slip pagination only; no Idaho Reports / P.3d pagination
PDF URL carries an unpredictable timestamp
